name: Alembic Pharmaceuticals Ltd
title: Alembic Pharmaceuticals Ltd - 533573 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Alembic guides FY27 low double-digit revenue growth and 100-150bps Pivya drag, with R&D rising to INR750-800 crores; API pricing still a headwind and no capacity-discipline signal beyond capex of INR300-350 crores.

utilisation.quote: Capacity utilization is improving, and this gives us a better base for supply reliability

capex.quote: We expect capital expenditure for the year to be in the range of INR300 crores to INR350 crores, primarily towards capacity, debottlenecking and replacement capex.

triggers.label: API pricing still a headwind
triggers.quote: The API business delivered a modest growth in Q4, driven primarily by volumes, while pricing remained a headwind.

triggers.label: F3 ophthalmic line at full capacity
triggers.quote: the ophthalmic line is already chock-a-block

triggers.label: Pivya drag 100-150bps in FY27
triggers.quote: I would take about 100 to 150 basis points of impact coming from Pivya

triggers.label: FY27 revenue low double-digit growth
triggers.quote: we are targeting a low double -digit growth, top line growth

guidance.quote: we are targeting a low double -digit growth, top line growth
R&D investments are likely to be around INR750 crores to INR800 crores
We expect capital expenditure for the year to be in the range of INR300 crores to INR350 crores
I would take about 100 to 150 basis points of impact coming from Pivya
I expect the U.S. business to grow between 10% to 15% at least.

red_flags.label: Q4 tax one-off inflates PAT
red_flags.quote: onetime tax adjustments of INR101 crores, which is a positive impact relating to MAT Credit

red_flags.label: R&D 11% of revenue vs guided 8-9%
red_flags.quote: Q4 was a little bit of an outlier at 11% of sales is a little higher than we would have liked to be.

evasions.quote: I don't want to put a number to this
No, no, I'm not giving any guidance. Let's see how the first couple of quarters go
We haven't given a disclosure because it's a part of an already ongoing and existing API facility
